prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your industry, goals, channels, budget and company size. I can recommend agencies once I know more, but here’s a quick way to find the best fit plus some widely respected options with SF presence.

Quick questions to narrow it down
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, SEO, paid ads, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Company size and stage (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Any required specialties (B2B SaaS, consumer, paid search, SEO, creative, UX, analytics)?
- Timeline and contract preference (project vs retainer)?

Well‑known agencies with San Francisco presence (examples)
- AKQA — creative + product design, enterprise/innovation focus
- R/GA — creative, digital product, brand transformation
- Huge — UX, CX and integrated digital experiences
- Merkle — data‑driven performance marketing and CRM
- Wpromote — performance marketing, paid media and growth

How to choose the right agency (short checklist)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for businesses like yours
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence
- Team you’ll work with (experience and availability)
- Tech stack and integrations (analytics, attribution, CRM)
- Pricing model and minimum commitment; ability to run a pilot/test
- Client references and reviews (Clutch, G2, LinkedIn)
- Cultural fit and communication style

Where to research more
- Clutch.co and G2 for reviews and categories
- LinkedIn for agency team and client posts
- Industry lists (AdAge, Adweek, Forrester) for enterprise vendors

If you want, tell me your goals, budget and company type and I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies tailored to your needs and suggest questions to ask during discovery calls. Which details can you share?
